about: A web app that keeps Docker containers updated automatically.

prs.title: Updated containers keep their input open
prs.broken: When the tool updated a container that was started to accept input, it recreated it without that setting. Some containers then stopped right away, and others ignored typed input.
prs.changed: The setting is now copied over when the container is recreated.
prs.matters: Automatic updates no longer break containers that rely on input.
